journey.name: wear receive paid ambient
journey.description:
An invoice paid while the watch is in ambient mode shows the check without the amount, so the always-on screen shows no amount; waking the watch shows the amount. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Restored wallet on the local ./spark stack, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack and › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped, and the always-on screen on (README › Watch gestures). Gestures are written for the 454 px screen; scale them as in README › What differs.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left once: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Read the invoice from the log as in README › Reading the receive invoice and note it as <invoice>
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceiveHidden" is listed
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark pay <invoice> 1000` from this repo's parent checkout
Wait up to 20 s until "WatchReceivePaid" is listed
Wait up to 5 s until "WatchReceivePaidAmount" reads "1 000"
